Reason for separation from each employer
Alien Registration Card if not a U.S. citizen

name: Arizona Voter Registration
description: Register to vote or update your registration in Arizona. Arizona requires documentary proof of citizenship to vote a full ballot (all federal, state, county, and local races); without it you can register as a federal-only voter. Register online through AZ MVD Now with an Arizona driver license or ID.
eligibility: U.S. citizen and Arizona resident of the county listed on registration
At least 18 years old by the date of the next regular general election
Not convicted of a felony without restored civil rights; not adjudicated incapacitated
Documentary proof of citizenship required for a full ballot (state form); federal form requires attestation under penalty of perjury

deadlines.label: Registration cutoff
deadlines.note: Register at least 29 days before an election; no same-day registration in Arizona

prerequisites: Arizona driver license or non-operating ID for online registration via AZ MVD Now EZ Voter Registration
Proof of citizenship (AZ license/ID number, tribal ID, naturalization certificate, passport, or birth certificate with name documentation) for a full ballot
whatToBring: Arizona driver license or ID number
Proof of citizenship documents if registering by mail (do not send originals)

contacts.label: Registering to vote — Arizona Secretary of State

applyLinks.label: AZ MVD Now EZ Voter Registration

name: Arizona Business Registration — LLC & Corporation Formation
description: Form an LLC or corporation in Arizona through the Corporation Commission's Corporations Division. The legacy eCorp portal was retired in January 2026 and replaced by Arizona Business Connect; start at the Corporations Division page to file articles of organization or incorporation online.
eligibility: Any person forming a domestic entity or registering a foreign entity to transact business in Arizona
Entity name must be distinguishable from existing Arizona entities
Every corporation and LLC must maintain a statutory agent with a physical street address in Arizona

deadlines.label: Filing
deadlines.note: Rolling — file before transacting business; annual reports due on the anniversary of incorporation

Statutory agent with an Arizona street address who accepts the appointment
Articles of organization (LLC) or incorporation (corporation)

name: Arizona Individual Income Tax — File with ADOR
description: File and pay Arizona individual income tax through the Department of Revenue. Arizona has a flat individual income tax; file and pay online through AZTaxes.gov, where you can also track refunds, make estimated payments, and arrange payments without registering.
eligibility: Arizona residents, part-year residents, and nonresidents with Arizona-source income meeting filing thresholds
Single filers generally must file if Arizona adjusted gross income or gross income meets the thresholds on Form 140 instructions

deadlines.label: Individual return
deadlines.note: Generally due April 15 (follows the federal deadline); estimated payments due quarterly

prerequisites: Complete your federal return first (Arizona starts from federal adjusted gross income)
AZTaxes.gov account for managing filings (not required for one-time estimated, extension, or liability payments)
whatToBring: Social Security number and filing status
Records of estimated payments and withholding
Bank account information for direct deposit or ACH payment

name: Arizona Registrar of Contractors — Contractor Licensing
description: Arizona's largest occupational licensing agency: the Registrar of Contractors licenses residential and commercial contractors. Arizona has no single central portal for all professions — most professions (nursing, real estate, medical, cosmetology) are licensed through their own boards; Arizona's universal licensing law also lets many out-of-state licensees apply by endorsement.
eligibility: Contractors performing work over the statutory minimum must hold an ROC license in the proper classification
Qualifying party must pass the business management and trade exams (via PSI) unless waived
Background check, bond, and applicable fees required with the application

deadlines.label: Licensing
deadlines.note: Rolling — apply before contracting; licenses renew on a two-year cycle

prerequisites: Qualifying party meeting experience requirements for the license classification
Passed Statutes & Rules and trade exams (or approved waiver)
Background check through the Registrar's vendor and contractor's bond
whatToBring: Completed license application package for the business entity type
Government-issued ID for the qualifying party and listed individuals
Proof of bond and payment for application and license fees

name: Arizona Birth Certificate — Vital Records
agency: Arizona Department of Health Services, Office of Vital Records
description: Order a certified copy of an Arizona birth certificate from the state Office of Vital Records. Apply by mail with the official request form, in person at county vital records offices, or online through VitalChek for expedited service. The state office no longer offers same-day walk-in issuance.
eligibility: The person named on the record, a parent, or an entitled party with proof of relationship
State office holds records for births since July 1909 (abstracts of earlier county-filed records)
County health department vital records offices can issue certified copies for same-day walk-in service

Copy of government photo ID (front and back) or notarized signature
Proof of relationship if ordering for someone other than yourself
whatToBring: Copy of valid signed government photo ID
Proof of relationship (birth certificate, court documents, marriage certificate) if applicable
Money order or cashier's check payable to Bureau of Vital Records (no personal checks); self-addressed stamped envelope

name: Cash Assistance (TANF) — Arizona
agency: Arizona Department of Economic Security, Family Assistance Administration
description: Cash Assistance is Arizona's TANF program, providing temporary monthly cash benefits to eligible low-income families with dependent children. Benefits are deposited on the QUEST EBT card; adults must sign a Personal Responsibility Agreement covering work participation, child support cooperation, and school requirements.
eligibility: Needy Arizona family with a dependent child (parent or non-parent relative head of household)
Countable income below the payment standard for the assistance unit
Arizona residency; citizenship or qualified non-citizen status
Adults limited to 12 Arizona months of Cash Assistance unless exempt or extended

deadlines.label: Applications
deadlines.note: Rolling — apply anytime; a decision is made no later than 45 days after application

Sign the Personal Responsibility Agreement before payments begin
Cooperate with child support enforcement and Jobs Program participation
whatToBring: Photo ID and Social Security numbers for people applying

Bank or credit union statement for the most recent month
Rent/mortgage and utility bills; children's birth certificates
Information about the children's other parent for child support

Pass valid for one year from purchase at all Arizona state parks
Does not cover camping fees, cave tours, or special programs
